# lemo-mod **English** · [**简体中文**](README.zh-CN.md) **Re-skin Claude Code in one click, with a full set of features you turn on when you need them.**
**21 styles for the terminal and the desktop app.**

**21 套风格，终端和桌面 App 都能用。** [**▶ See every style · 看全部风格**](https://lemomo-ai.github.io/lemo-mod/)
## What is lemo-mod · lemo-mod 是什么 lemo-mod is a set of style mods built on Claude Code's official mod interface. Once installed, Claude Code in the terminal and in the desktop app's Code tab can switch styles in one click. Colors, pixel mascot, spinner words, sounds and names all change together. Beyond looks, lemo-mod provides a full set of features, including a four-page panel, a usage band, a status line, message numbers and reply tags, sounds, speech, brief mode, reminders, a focus timer, notes, session recaps, per-turn stats, a time limit, a log, auto tags, a lot-drawing tool and a read-only assistant. Your settings are only read, never changed, and every feature beyond looks is yours to turn on. > [!NOTE] > **中文读者请看这里。** lemo-mod 是一组基于 Claude Code 官方 mod 接口的风格化 mod。装上之后，终端里的 Claude Code 和桌面 App 的 Code 标签都能一键换风格，配色、像素小画、加载词、音效和名字一起换。 > > 除了外观，lemo-mod 还提供一整套功能，包括四页面板、用量横条、状态栏、消息编号和回复标签、音效、朗读、简短模式、定时提醒、番茄钟、笔记、会话小结、每轮统计、限时、日志、自动分类、抽签工具和一个只读助手。你的设置只读不改，外观以外的功能都由你自己开启。 > > **→ [阅读中文版 README](README.zh-CN.md)** ## What you get

**Looks are on from the start.** Your messages get numbers like `T01` and `T02`, and each of Claude's replies shows which one it answers. Tool rows, turn lines and spinner words take on the style. A band above the prompt shows context, the 5-hour quota, cost and git branch, with a status line below it. Claude's question dialog gets a header. Type `/lemo-mod` to open the panel, with four pages: Main, Behavior, Background and Safety. **The first time you open it, the panel starts on the Safety page.** Read what each feature does, turn on the ones you want, and press **I have read this**. # lemo-wake **把你的照片叫醒**
**Wake your image.** 一张图进去，一段约 5 秒、无缝循环的动图出来。
One picture in, a seamless loop of about five seconds out. [**▶ 去作品墙看看 See the gallery**](https://lemomo-ai.github.io/lemo-wake/) · [**▶ Logo 动效 Logo Motion**](https://lemomo-ai.github.io/lemo-wake/logos/) **New (2026-10-15):** [Logo Motion](https://lemomo-ai.github.io/lemo-wake/logos/), a wall of 56 brand logos, each woken up by lemo-wake. **English** | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)
> **中文用户请看这里：[完整中文说明 README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)**
> English readers: keep reading below. ## What it does 它做什么 Give Claude Code one picture and say "make it move". You get a loop of about 5 seconds whose end joins its start seamlessly. Photos, portraits, posters, illustrations, logos, charts, stickers, Xiaohongshu covers and chat screenshots all work. It is not a filter. Claude first reads the image, takes it apart into text, shapes, objects, people and light, rebuilds the pieces in code and choreographs a short film for this one picture. It then renders the frames in a headless browser, joins the end back to the start and encodes the result. - **No image generation.** Everything comes from your picture, from code and from small local models. - **No API keys.** No cloud services. Everything runs on your machine. - **Your size, your formats.** It asks once: keep your image's size or pick another ratio, and which formats you want. **中文简介** 把一张图交给 Claude Code，说一句“让它动起来”，就能拿到一段约 5 秒、首尾无缝相接的动图。照片、人像、海报、插画、Logo、图表、表情包、小红书封面、聊天截图都可以。 这不是套滤镜。Claude 会先读懂画面，把文字、图形、物体、人物和光拆开，用代码重建，再为这张图编排一段专属的动作。最后在无头浏览器里逐帧渲染，把结尾接回开头，编码出片。 - **不生图**：素材只来自你的图、代码和本地小模型。 - **不用 API key**：不连云服务，全部在你的电脑上完成。 - **尺寸和格式你来选**：开始前问一次，保持原图尺寸还是换个比例，要哪几种格式。 **How it works 流程**

# Codex Radar
**Find what slows down your Codex workflow. Leave with one concrete move to try next.**
Codex Radar turns your existing project sessions into a personal collaboration report: where work gets stuck, which habits help, and what to change in your next session. Copy a tailored prompt or workflow, then come back to see whether the measured behavior improved.
[中文](README_zh.md) · [Try the demo](https://lemomo-ai.github.io/codex-radar/demo.html) · [Website](https://lemomo-ai.github.io/codex-radar/) · [Methodology](docs/METHODOLOGY.md)
## From “that took too long” to a better next session
- **Find the bottleneck.** See your strongest pattern and most costly friction across communication, engineering, and observable outcomes. Open the cited message, session, or incident behind a recommendation.
- **Get an action you can use.** Copy a project-specific prompt, follow a short workflow, or adopt a setup-file draft. Suggestions are prioritized by the evidence; smaller samples receive shorter plans.
- **Check whether you improved.** The next comparable report checks structured targets such as edits followed by passing verification. It separates changes in formula scores from changes in model interpretation.
- **Review the period that matters.** Analyze all history, the last 30 days, or a chosen date range. Reports adapt to one-off tasks, feature work, long-running projects, learning, and automation.
- **Keep control of your evidence.** Standard mode removes common credentials. Strict mode also leaves out message and command excerpts, thread titles, search queries, and session opening/closing text.
The report is a bilingual, self-contained HTML file with a nine-dimension radar, a focused action plan, progress checks, and expandable evidence. It opens without a server. [Explore a complete synthetic example →](https://lemomo-ai.github.io/codex-radar/demo.html)

Requires a Codex CLI with plugin support and **Node.js 20+**. No dependencies to install, no separate API key.
```bash

codex plugin add codex-radar@codex-radar-marketplace
```
